BiblicalUsage: Epha means nothing, worthless, a breath. God taunts the idols with it: behold, ye are of nothing, and your work of nought — an abomination is he that chooseth you. The word is God's verdict on every rival.
TheologicalSignificance: Every idol, weighed honestly, comes to nothing, and only God remains when the scales settle.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
